lines.text: For forty years, Tom has kept this lighthouse burning.
Tonight, a cargo ship is heading straight into a storm.
And the lamp has two hours of oil left.
Yesterday, the tank was full.
Someone is stealing the oil.
There's only one other person on this island.
Sam. The new assistant.
Sam arrived a week ago.
The oil started vanishing a week ago.
Tom hasn't slept properly since.
So tonight, he spreads flour across the floor,
and pretends to sleep.
Midnight. Slow footsteps on the stairs.
In the morning, there are flour prints everywhere.
He follows them, ready to catch Sam in the act.
They lead straight back to his own bed.
His own boots are covered in flour.
Tom has been sleepwalking.
Every night, he empties the tank himself.
Sam never touched a drop.
But next to his prints, there's a second trail.
Smaller. Barefoot.
And it doesn't belong to Sam.
